briefdescription.para: inject embed_fn that throws std::runtime_error — must NOT propagate. The EmbeddedLLM must fall back to its deterministic embedding path and return a non-empty result.
inject embed_fn that throws an int — must NOT propagate.
After a throwing callback the fallback result is cached. A second call with the same input must return the identical cached value.
inject generate_full_fn that throws — must NOT propagate; must return a well-formed (possibly failure) response.
inject generate_full_fn that throws a bare char* — must NOT propagate.
inject generate_full_fn that returns OK, but stream_callback throws. The generate call must complete without crashing.
Construct EmbeddedLLM, install throwing embed_fn, call embed(), then let the object go out of scope. Destructor must not throw.
A default-constructed EmbeddedLLM must be safely destroyable.
GGUFLoader destructor must be declared noexcept (verified at compile-time via type trait).
KVCacheBuffer destructor must be declared noexcept.
When the flush callback throws, the destructor must absorb the exception and NOT propagate it (which would call std::terminate).
Same as above but the callback throws a non-std type.

Calling parseFile() twice on the same GGUFLoader must not crash or leak the first file descriptor/mmap (fixed by releaseResources() guard). Both calls will fail (no real GGUF file), which is expected.
GGUFLoader destroyed after a failed parse must not crash.
Default construct + immediate destroy must not crash.
embed() on a default-constructed EmbeddedLLM must return a non-empty, unit-normalised vector (deterministic fallback).
generate() on a default-constructed EmbeddedLLM must not crash.
isReady() and getModelInfo() must be safe on a default-constructed object.
clearCache() on an empty or already-cleared EmbeddedLLM must not crash.
embedBatch() must produce the same result as calling embed() on each element individually.
If the injected callback throws for every call, embedBatch() must still return a result for every input (deterministic fallback per item).
embedBatch({}) must return an empty vector without crashing.
After initialize(), get() must return a valid reference.

detaileddescription.para: Note: EmbeddedLLMManager::get() in the stub implementation auto-initializes (never throws) for backwards compatibility. The test validates the contract that get() after explicit initialize() works.

briefdescription.para: Launch N threads all calling embed() on the same EmbeddedLLM. No crash, no data race (verified by TSan when enabled), all results must be non-empty.
Interleave embed() and clearCache() from multiple threads. No crash.
Construct EmbeddedLLM, perform a small embed(), let the object destruct. Must not crash and the object must be properly destroyed.
Same as above but ownership held via unique_ptr to confirm heap-allocated instances are properly destroyed.
generate() must return a response (success or failure) without crashing even when no backend is configured.
Construct and destroy EmbeddedLLM 100 times. No crash; memory must not grow unboundedly (regression guard against per-cycle leaks).
50 cycles of: populate cache with 10 unique strings → clearCache() → verify size returns to zero (stats report 0 entries after clear).
After the EmbeddedLLM is destroyed, a new instance must compute fresh embeddings (no shared state leaking across instances).
Populate the cache with many entries, then clear and confirm the EmbeddedLLM can still serve embed() requests (no dangling state).
Append 512-token batch into KVCacheBuffer, trigger explicit flush, then clear(). Stats must show 0 pending tokens after clear.
Populate KVCacheBuffer and destroy it without calling flush(). Destructor must absorb any flush-callback exceptions and exit cleanly.
Acquire and release all pool buffers 20 times. No crash.
Construct GrammarCache, insert entries, clear, destroy. Must not crash at any step.
When the cache is at capacity, inserting a new key must fail (current policy: no eviction, returns false). Existing entries remain intact.
Inserting the same name twice must update the entry, not double-count.
